title: When and under which change are the overlap, retirement and agent-permission packets raised?
context: The change raises one authoring.overlap packet per colliding skill or agent pair, authoring.retirement packets for skills that never fired, and authoring.agent_permission packets for agent powers. Agent-permission packets are tied to the agent file's exact content, so they must come after the agent files are final. A packet under this change id holds only this change's remaining edits; a packet with no change holds every change until it is answered. The owner already chose one PR for the whole issue.
